name: Halvar — creatures you control that are enchanted or equipped have double strike
notes: Memory: project_halvar_sword_equip_fixes_2026-05-19. The tokenizer read 'enchanted' and 'equipped' as creature subtypes so the filter matched nothing. Pacifism'd Grizzly Bears and Bonesplitter'd Runeclaw Bear (both mine) must gain double strike; plain Vampire Nighthawk must not; the opponent's enchanted Giant Spider must not ('you control'). The Sword equip-cost half of the memory needs the activated-ability list and is not expressible here.
